sentences.en: My sister-in-law lived through the poverty of her modish Western religion.
sentences.zh: 我妹夫经历了他们那套流行的西方宗教的贫困。

sentences.en: My neighbours are always pushing their modish Western religion.
sentences.zh: 邻居们总是推崇他们的时髦的西方宗教。

sentences.en: They are still fighting their modish Western religion.
sentences.zh: 他们还在为那个时髦的西方宗教而斗争。
